mapper.select: WITH TripStats AS ( SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.total_target_amount, COALESCE(SUM(tr.amount), 0) AS total_spent, DATEDIFF(t.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS remaining_trip_days FROM trips t LEFT JOIN transactions tr ON t.id = tr.trip_id AND tr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{tripId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id ) SELECT (ts.total_target_amount - ts.total_spent) AS total_remaining_fund, CASE WHEN ts.remaining_trip_days > 0 THEN (ts.total_target_amount - ts.total_spent) / ts.remaining_trip_days ELSE 0 END AS daily_available_amount, c.country_name, tc.target_budget - COALESCE(SUM(tr.amount), 0) AS country_remaining_fund, DATEDIFF(tc.departure_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS remaining_days FROM TripStats ts JOIN trip_countries tc ON ts.trip_id = tc.trip_id JOIN countries c ON tc.country_id = c.id LEFT JOIN transactions tr ON tc.id = tr.trip_country_id AND tr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE tc.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ts.trip_id, tc.id, c.country_name, tc.target_budget, tc.departure_date, ts.total_target_amount, ts.total_spent, ts.remaining_trip_days

WITH Budget AS ( SELECT (SELECT SUM(target_budget) FROM trip_countries WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND country_id = #{countryId} ) AS target_budget, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(direct_amount) FROM pre_expenses pe JOIN transactions tr ON pe.transaction_id = tr.id WHERE pe.trip_id = #{tripId} AND pe.trip_country_id = (SELECT id FROM trip_countries WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND country_id = #{countryId}) ), 0) AS pre_expense_total, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND is_pre_expense = 0 AND trip_country_id = (SELECT id FROM trip_countries WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND country_id = #{countryId}) ), 0) AS travel_expense_total ) SELECT b.target_budget, b.pre_expense_total, b.travel_expense_total, (b.target_budget - (b.pre_expense_total + b.travel_expense_total)) AS remaining_fund, sc.category_name, COALESCE(SUM(tr.amount), 0) AS amount, (COALESCE(SUM(tr.amount), 0) / NULLIF(b.travel_expense_total, 0) * 100) AS percentage FROM Budget b LEFT JOIN transactions tr ON tr.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tr.is_deleted = 0 AND tr.is_pre_expense = 0 AND tr.trip_country_id = (SELECT id FROM trip_countries WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND country_id = #{countryId}) LEFT JOIN spending_categories sc ON tr.category_id = sc.id GROUP BY sc.category_name, b.target_budget, b.pre_expense_total, b.travel_expense_total
